comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body: That is very interesting, do you know by how much it decreases the consumption?

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
It is known that the amount of fuel consumption decrease from 11 to 4 per sailing day on KOR server. But I have not confirmed on our Maris yet.

Condition:
1) Your nation is NOT under IR.
2) Your Management Skill is 15R
3) You have "Master of Steam" title(O) .

comments.author: GudeBuddha
comments.body:
I can confirm that you can get fuel consumption with that effect down to 4 without IR. (With "Master of Steam" title and Managment 15).

What i dont understand is how it is calculated.
Base fuel consumption without IR is 18 (with 10-14 Managment), with this effect it goes down to 8, a 55.5% decrease.
Fuel consumption without IR but with "Master of Steam" title is 12, with this effect it goes down to 5, a 58.3% decrease.

My guess so far is that it is something like a 55% decrease and then rounded down. Have to test more once Portugal is in IR again.

Also i have only tested the [Common Bonfire so far, i dont have enough sofia points for Victorious Bonfire. But it looks like the effect is the same but with higher duration.

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body: Thanks to Beomi i got some Victorious Bonfire and can confirm the buff is the same but with a 3h duration. Outside IR it gets fuel consumption from base 18 (10 Managment) down to 8. In IR this buff alone gets the fuel consumption down from 3 to 1, without the need to get to Managment 15 and the Steam Title.
